name: Biological and Biomedical Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 dates and admission model were not explicitly confirmed. GRE policy was not stated on the opened program pages.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application review begins
publishedDeadlines.note: Domestic and international program date; later applications before university deadlines may be reviewed if space remains.

applicationFee.note: One-time codes for current Oakland undergraduates, military/veterans, McNair and institutional agreements. Special recruitment events may offer codes. Obtain before submission; international applicants must verify a qualifying affiliation.

english.note: PTE Academic 53 also accepted; tests at most two years old at enrollment. US degree or overseas bachelor/graduate degree taught in English is an alternative; listed citizenship exemptions also exist. Program may require higher proficiency.

documents: Three recommendations evaluating scientific research potential
Essay on program interests, graduate-study expectations and career goals
NACES course-by-course evaluation for last degree earned abroad
International supplemental application and financial certification for F/J visa
requirements.note: Bachelor equivalent; department GPA 3.0 with possible exceptions. Background: biology 20 credits, mathematics 8, physics 8, chemistry 15; deficiencies may permit conditional admission. Catalog additionally emphasizes physics, calculus and statistics.

funding.note: Limited teaching/research assistantships provide stipend and tuition/fee awards; faculty-grant research assistantships also available. No universal guarantee.
